public.title: Longest Palindrome
public.description: Return the largest possible length of a palindrome that can be built by rearranging some or all characters of text. Characters are case-sensitive ASCII letters; length is 0 to 10000. Return a length, not a substring.
hints: Every noncentral character needs a matching copy.
At most one unmatched occurrence can occupy the center.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Use every available pair and optionally one remaining odd character. O(n) time and O(1) alphabet space.
